==About==

{{i|Candied Yams}} must be Cooked over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a Fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}. Candied Yams is a major [[Restore Food]] for the {{i2|Potato Food}} Food Group.
